Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The item shall be fabricated as per drawing at Annexure-I.

2. The item shall accompany all applicable test reports, dimensional reports and CoCs wherever applicable . 3. Inspection & Acceptance: At vendor’s work by BDL(QC)/NSTL(PINA). The item will be inspected in accord ance with Annexure-I. Acceptance based on test reports, CoCs and ORI (On Receipt Inspection) at BDL as p er Annexure-I. 4. Vendor must inform in writing to the inspection agency well in advance for providing inspection coverag e. 5. The party shall provide all Technical reports and inspection reports details to BDL. 6. Delivery Schedule: All items within 03 months from the date of receipt of vetted PO. 7. Vendor should deliver the items at free of cost at BDL(Stores), Visakhapatnam. 8. 06 sets of spiral bounded copies of all applicable test reports, duly approved by BDL(QC) and PINA(NSTL ) are to be submitted along with the items to BDL-stores. 9. Payment terms: 100% payment with in 30days from the date of receipt and acceptance of the item BDL- VU. 10. “BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GST R-2B/2 A 9 / 12 within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law”. 11. LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to de liver the goods / service, with i n the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Inclu ding duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part there of, subject to a maximum of 10%.In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be bor ne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 12. AS 9100D Clause: •Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. •Supplier shall notify BDL of non-conforming processes, products or services and obtain approval for theird isposition (i.e. rework, rejection etc.,). •Supplier shall notify BDL of changes to manufacturing processes, products or services including changes of their external providers or location of manufacture and obtain BDL approval. •Supplier shall retain the product related records (processes, quality records etc.,) up to 3years. •BDL, its customer and regulatory authorities having right of access to the applicable areas of all your facili ties, at any level of supply chain, involved in our order and all applicable records. 7 / 10 •Supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase order be aware of product conformity requirements, product safety and importance of ethical behavior etc. •Wherever drawing revisions are applicable, old drawings are to be returned to BDL or to be destroyed wit h an intimation to BDL. •Wherever applicable, ESD controls to be followed for PCB and other electronics items. •In case of any corrective action plan against non-conforming product reported/identified at any stage the same shall be brought to the notice of BDL for approval before its implementation. •"Supplier shall not use any suspected/detected counterfeit parts" during any stage of manufacturing. •Counterfeit parts shall not be supplied to BDL. If any counterfeit parts are received, severe action shall b e initiated against the supplier. •Vendor shall comply ISO 14001:2015 EMS for the PO. 13. BDL will not acknowledge receipt of goods or service as a valid supply/ service, until all mandatory doc uments listed in purchase Order (e.g., inspection report, free issue material consumption report, warranty certificate, ePBG, GST invoice) are provided. A checklist of submitted documents is required with each sup ply. within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law".

14. The bidder should submit the compliance statement for acceptance of attached specifications and all t erms & conditions as per the said bid. 15. The vendor participating in the tender should declare if demerged in the recent times, to declare the m erge, nature of demerger for the assessment of the credentials for acceptance of your quotations, falling o n which knowing of the demerger in the later stage by bdl, bdl will entitle the vendor for debarment. .
